1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array coupled to a signal source via a transmission line having a transmission line impedance; receiving a signal from the signal source; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder by applying a transformation based on a quadratic form of the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, and a signal source impedance, such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, wherein the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form with respect to the corresponding precoder; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is computed based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array as seen at the signal source.

3. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form incorporates a matching network impedance between the signal source and the antenna array.

4. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is computed based on an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line, and wherein the transformation accounts for electromagnetic coupling effects in the transmission line.

5. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied, wherein the transmit power is determined by the quadratic form.

6. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 5, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form computed from the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance matrix.

7. (Original) The method according to claim 5, further comprising transmitting a scaling factor used for the scaling.

8. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix derived from the quadratic form such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having equal transmit power.

9. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 8, wherein the transformation matrix is computed based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array, and wherein the transformation matrix accounts for electromagnetic coupling between the transmission line and the antenna array.

10. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders by accounting for power loss and impedance mismatch in the transmission line.

11. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines having non-negligible impedance are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.

12. (Original) The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation.

13. (Original) The method according to claim 12, further comprising: receiving a precoded signal including reference symbols; estimating channels for the reference symbols; estimating a channel for the data symbols by taking an inner product of a conjugate of a data symbol precoder and the reference symbol channel estimates; and demodulating received data symbols based on the estimated channel.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: an antenna array; a transceiver coupled to the antenna array; a signal source coupled to the transceiver; a transmission line coupled between the signal source and the antenna array, the transmission line having a transmission line impedance; a memory to store a codebook including a plurality of precoders; and a controller coupled to the transceiver and the memory, the controller configured to: receive a plurality of precoders from the codebook; compute a quadratic form based on the transmission line impedance, an impedance matrix of the antenna array, and a signal source impedance; transform each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder by applying a transformation based on the quadratic form such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form with respect to the corresponding precoder; receive a signal from the signal source; and apply a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel, wherein the transceiver transmits the precoded signal.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the quadratic form is computed based on at least one selected from an impedance matrix of the antenna array, a matching network impedance between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied, wherein the transmit power is determined by the quadratic form.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 16, wherein scaling comprises normalizing a precoder into a normalized precoder based on the quadratic form computed from the transmission line impedance and antenna array impedance matrix.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix derived from the quadratic form such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having equal transmit power.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 18, wherein the transformation matrix is computed based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array, and wherein the transformation matrix accounts for electromagnetic coupling between the transmission line and the antenna array.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when transmission lines having non-negligible impedance are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.
